cc.title: Command centre
cc.oldest: The oldest application has waited more than 5 days.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Every account on MediLink: the platform team, facility staff and patients. Patients appear as accounts only, never with their health records.
users.search: Search by name, email or phone
users.exportHint: CSV of staff and the platform team, never patients.
users.exportFailed: The export did not download. Try again.
users.patientNote: This is a patient account. MediLink shows only the account here: the patient's records stay with the facilities that care for them.

access.title: Facility access
access.lead: Where this person works and what they can do there. Facility admins manage roles; you can remove or restore access.
access.removeConfirm: {{name}} can no longer work at {{facility}}. Their other facilities and their account stay as they are.
access.restoreConfirm: {{name}} can work at {{facility}} again, with the roles they had.

users.noChanges: No admin has changed this account.
users.editLead: Correct the name, work phone or language. The email address and the password can't be changed here.
users.phoneHint: A Rwandan mobile number, for example 0788 123 456.
users.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log. At least 5 characters.
users.actionsNote: Each action asks you to confirm your identity again and is recorded with your reason.

notice.self: This is your own account. Change your details and security from your profile.
notice.locked: This account is locked: the person can't sign in.
notice.blocked_one: Sign-in is blocked for {{count}} more minute after too many failed attempts.
notice.blocked_other: Sign-in is blocked for {{count}} more minutes after too many failed attempts.
notice.pending: The person signed up but hasn't opened the confirmation link, so they can't sign in yet.
notice.mfa: Two-step login isn't set up. The person is asked to set it up at the next sign-in.

hints.lock: Stops every sign-in until you unlock it.
hints.unlock: Lets the person sign in again.
hints.reset-mfa: For a lost or new phone: they set it up again at the next sign-in.
hints.revoke-sessions: Ends every session on every device.
hints.send-password-reset: Emails a one-time link to their own address. You never see the password.
hints.resend-verification: Sends the sign-up confirmation link again.
hints.clear-sign-in-block: Lets them try again now instead of waiting.

confirm.lock: {{name}} can't sign in until the account is unlocked. Every session ends now.
confirm.reset-mfa: {{name}} sets up two-step login again at the next sign-in. Every session ends now.
confirm.revoke-sessions: {{name}} is signed out on every device.
confirm.send-password-reset: {{name}} gets an email with a link to choose a new password. The link works once.
confirm.resend-verification: {{name}} gets the sign-up confirmation email again.
confirm.clear-sign-in-block: {{name}} can try to sign in again now. Confirm it is really them who asked.

done.send-password-reset: Sent to {{email}}. Ask the person to check their inbox and spam folder.
done.resend-verification: Sent to {{email}}. Ask the person to check their inbox and spam folder.

logs.immutable: Log entries are chained and can't be changed or deleted.

security.title: Security log
security.lead: Sign-ins, two-step login, lockouts and admin actions on accounts.

access.title: Record access log
access.lead: Who opened which record, with the reason given. Records are shown by reference only.

bg.title: Break-glass reviews
bg.lead: Emergency access to records, reviewed by a second admin.

national.title: National report
national.intro: How the network ran over a period: load by district and facility, the wait to see a doctor, the most common diagnoses and medicines out of stock. Figures only, never a patient.
national.failed: The report could not load. Try again.
national.hiddenWhy: Fewer than 10 patients, or a figure that would reveal such a group.

districts.title: Load by district
districts.intro: Visits and the wait from arrival to the doctor's call.

facilitiesTable.title: Load by facility
facilitiesTable.intro: A small facility's visits are hidden, and so is the next smallest in its district, so the district total can't give it away.

trend.title: Wait trend
trend.intro: Median and 90th percentile wait to the doctor, across all facilities.
trend.hiddenPeriods_one: {{count}} period is hidden: fewer than 10 patients were called.
trend.hiddenPeriods_other: {{count}} periods are hidden: fewer than 10 patients were called.

diagnoses.title: Top diagnoses by district
diagnoses.intro: Signed visits; only diagnoses seen 10 times or more, and sensitive diagnoses never.

stockouts.title: Stock-outs now
stockouts.intro: Medicines with no usable stock today, wherever stock is tracked.
